notes.title: Inn Tycoon is coming sooner than expected!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As you may have noticed we changed the release date of Inn Tycoon (full game) from Aug 28th to Aug 26th! We want to be honest, the reason for this change is to increase store visibility and reach for a wider audience. This is our first PC game and we are so excited to show it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069415/f2af7af732a03be55bfb1248a2722a7da0afba72.gif[/img]

❤️ from Evil Goose Games
